verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe checkpointers persisting thread graph state so execution can resume even from an error state, with production-grade backends like PostgresSaver, and GitHub README states agents 'persist through failures... automatically resuming from exactly where they left off.' Community commentary corroborates the state-machine/time-travel design underlying this durability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of crash-recovery behavior (community only discusses persistence conceptually and flags rough edges in related streaming, not a concrete failure of checkpoint/resume itself).
